ios.desc:
OctoNote - GitHub Powered Markdown Notes

THE POWER OF GITHUB MEETS BEAUTIFUL NOTE-TAKING
OctoNote transforms the way developers and power users take notes by harnessing GitHub Gists—giving you cloud sync, version control, and universal access without the bloat of traditional note apps.

Write in markdown. Save to GitHub. Access anywhere.

MARKDOWN DONE RIGHT
- Gorgeous rendering that makes your notes look like miniature websites
- Full syntax highlighting for code blocks—perfect for developers
- Seamless editing with a clean, distraction-free interface
- Live preview to see your formatted notes as you write

GITHUB GISTS INTEGRATION
- Automatic sync to your GitHub profile—your notes live where your code lives
- Edit anywhere through GitHub's web interface or OctoNote
- Version history built in—never lose a previous version
- Share effortlessly via Gist URLs with beautiful browser rendering
- No vendor lock-in—your notes are standard markdown on GitHub

BUILT FOR DEVELOPERS & POWER USERS
Whether you're documenting code snippets, maintaining technical wikis, or organizing project notes, OctoNote gives you the tools you need:

- Save meeting notes with code examples
- Maintain personal knowledge bases
- Share formatted documentation instantly
- Keep research organized with tags and structure

OCTONOTE PREMIUM
Upgrade to unlock the full power of private note-taking:

- Secret Gists that don't appear in public search
- Custom syntax formatting themes (11+ beautiful options from Xcode Light to Atom One Dark)
- Flair for your app icon
- Private by default for sensitive work notes and personal journals

SIMPLE. POWERFUL. YOURS.
OctoNote doesn't try to be everything—it's focused on doing one thing exceptionally well: giving you beautiful, powerful markdown notes backed by the reliability of GitHub.
No proprietary formats. No complicated export processes. Just your notes, in standard markdown, stored safely on GitHub and accessible from anywhere.
Perfect for:

- Software developers and engineers
- Technical writers and documentation specialists
- Students studying computer science
- Anyone who loves markdown and wants their notes future-proof

REQUIREMENTS
OctoNote requires a GitHub account (free accounts work perfectly). All features—both standard and Premium—are available to users with any GitHub account tier.

Download OctoNote today and transform the way you take notes.

quotes.text:
I'm temperamental and have suffered the paralysis of a hundred note apps/techniques. I have a notebook I handwrite in too, but it's just one of the many approaches on the pile.

I was successful for a long time using GitHub Gists for notes, so much so in fact that I wrote an iOS client that lets you take markdown notes and saves them all directly to your Gists (OctoNote on iOS https://apps.apple.com/us/app/octonote/id1433164731) but since then I've added probably 5+ notes apps to the list.

Just for fun, my feature list includes:
* Markdown (ideally compatibility + basic styling)
* Project viewing (sidebar listing out notes, representing folder structure)
* Customizable themes/fonts
* Git integration (or other cloud backup)
* Mac app
* iOS app

I take notes in Markdown as [gists](https://gist.github.com/) on GitHub. The web editor for GitHub is pretty good, does excellent code formatting, and has some other web niceties. Plus all my stuff stays in one place.

I'm a little biased with this workflow because I wrote an iOS client that lets you manage notes as GitHub gists. If this flow sounds attractive you can check OctoNote out here: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/octonote/id1433164731
